details:
This update for aliyun-cli fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-116591: github.com/klauspost/compress/zstd: crafted ~27 KB two-block zstd frame makes DecodeAll and the
  streaming decoder panic (bsc#1288500).

Update to version 3.5.2:

 * fix: preserve command targets with leading --force by @pl0301 in (#1459)
 * fix(argparser): preserve object-like input in string arrays and
 stop consuming tokens after a complete JSON array by @AllyW in (#1463)
 * fix: read product help endpoints from canonical version metadata
 by @pl0301 in (#1466)
 * Fixed the issue of incorrect API parameter name values displayed by
 --help in non-plugin paths. by @yuexiu94 in (#1470)
 * fix: improve unknown OSS option diagnostics by @PanPanZou in (#1464)
 * fix: surface real pip error when plugin install fails (#1409)
 by @mengjunwei-mjw in (#1479)
 * fix: update Go security baseline and dependencies by @PanPanZou in (#1477)
 * fix: require HTTPS and checksums for plugin package installs
 by @yndu13 in (#1469)
 * fix: OAuth callback binding and add --no-browser login by @AllyW in (#1461)
 * fix: emit structured profile configuration errors in AI mode
 by @pl0301 in (#1476)
 * test: expand CLI unit coverage and failure recovery checks
 by @PanPanZou in (#1478)
 * fix: honor config path when refreshing OAuth and CloudSSO credentials
 by @PanPanZou in (#1468)
 * feat: support CLI credentials in MCP proxy by @PanPanZou in (#1465)
 * Sign release archives and publish an SBOM and provenance for each one
 by @yndu13 in (#1473)
 * fix: clarify safety policy configuration and confirmation boundaries
 by @Winphies in (#1480)
 * feat(openapi): tell "confirmed free" apart from "cannot be quoted" in
 --estimate-cost by @api-tool-agent in (#1410)
 * feat: apply API metadata read timeout defaults by @pl0301 in (#1475)
 * Add shared CloudSSO sessions across profiles by @AllyW in (#1481)
 * fix: validate JSON parameters as parent values by @Winphies in (#1485)
